story_type: swimmer lowered onto a moving fishing boat in white water, crewman basket-hoisted (door cam)
hook: A fishing boat 10 miles off Oregon. A crewman having seizures.
narration: A thirty-six foot fishing boat, ten miles off Oregon, with a crewman having seizures.
The Lacie Belle was north of Cape Blanco, pushing through white water.
A Coast Guard Dolphin helicopter lowered a rescue swimmer toward the moving deck.
The pilot can't see straight down, so the hoist operator talks him into position over the boat.
Then the basket went down into the spray.
[short pause] It came back up with the crewman inside.
outcome: The aircrew airlifted him off the boat and flew him to medical personnel at Bay Area Hospital in Coos Bay.

location_card.place: 10 miles north of Cape Blanco, Oregon

title: Seizures on a fishing boat off Oregon
description:
On May 4, 2018, a Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin aircrew from Sector North Bend airlifted a crewmember suffering seizures from the 36-foot fishing vessel Lacie Belle, about 10 miles north of Cape Blanco, Oregon, and took him to Bay Area Hospital in Coos Bay.
